je_pmr_aniline_inception = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_industry.dds"
	group = je_group_technology

	is_shown_when_inactive = { can_research = aniline }
	possible = { can_research = aniline }

	scripted_progress_bar = pmr_bar_aniline

	complete = {
		scope:journal_entry ?= { "scripted_bar_progress(pmr_bar_aniline)" >= 60 }
	}

	on_complete = {
		if = {
			limit = { can_research = aniline }
			add_technology_progress = { progress = 6250  technology = aniline }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { can_research = aniline }
			add_journal_entry = { type = je_pmr_aniline_development }
		}
		debug_log = "PMR_JE|inception|aniline|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
	}

	invalid = { has_technology_researched = aniline }

	weight = 1
	transferable = no
	can_revolution_inherit = yes
	should_be_pinned_by_default_uninvolved_or_context = no
}
